text:
Isla (Design): Quick design check 1 proposed suppression calendar UI: users can set single-range or recurring windows. Sketch: https://figma.redwood/suppression-calendar. Need accessibility & copy thoughts.

Marco (Eng): Backend will return recurrence rules and next occurrences. Suggest the preview shows the next 3 occurrences. Performance note: compute occurrences server-side.

Rita (A11y): SR guidance: announce when suppression is created and the next occurrence dates. Use short SR strings: "Suppression set: weekdays 09:00017 UTC; next occurrences Mar 24, Mar 25, Mar 26". Use aria-live=polite.

Dan (PM): Copy: prefer label "Suppression window" in UI. Helptext can read "(aka quiet window)". Also show timezone tag next to times.

Isla (Design): For recurrence preset names, do we say "Business hours" or "Weekdays 9-5"? Which is clearer?

Rita (A11y): Prefer explicit "Weekdays 9:00017:00 (your timezone)". Preset names are fine visually but SRs should speak full range.

Marco (Eng): Mobile collapse: show a summary pill "Suppressed: Weekdays 9-5" with aria-label listing next occurrences. Avoid loading full calendar on mobile.

Dan (PM): Also add an undo toast after creating a suppression: "Suppression created 0 Undo". Toast should be keyboard focusable and SR-announced.

Isla (Design): I'll update the mock: include next-3-occurrences line, explicit timezone tag, aria-live copy examples, and undo toast. ETA: EOD.

docs-bot: Reminder: update docs section "Scheduling suppressions" with examples and SR copy.

Rita (A11y): Happy to review the ARIA text before QA.

Isla (Design): Thanks all!
